simple.meaning: נָטָה (nâṭâh) appears 216 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 12:8. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, altar, Torah, mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָטָה (H5186) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָטָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: נָטָה (nâṭâh) / H5186 is tracked through Genesis 12:8, Genesis 24:14, Genesis 26:25, Genesis 33:19. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application (as follows)
